rubric.item: Reads CV-HOOK-01, opens the product page once with erp_url, uses main.jpg as the reference for one white-background main-angle candidate
rubric.note: The trace shows get_product, then one open_url to the product page, then main.jpg viewed and used as the reference.

rubric.item: Looks at the generated image before saving, compares it with the reference and the brand wording, and does not save the first image
rubric.note: gen_cv01_a was viewed and rejected without saving. The answer says the first image was not saved.

rubric.item: Names the 'Casa Vrede' defect as the reason to regenerate once, checks the second image and saves only that one as an added image
rubric.note: The answer names the misspelling as why it redid the image. gen_cv01_b was viewed, then saved alone as an added image, and main.jpg is still at rank 0.

rubric.item: Reports what it checked and that the image is a stored candidate (stored, total 4), with no claim of policy pass or approval, and leaves review to the user
rubric.note: The answer lists background, lettering, framing (完整入画) and square size, reports stored at position 4 with 4 images total, and says the check is not a review or an Amazon policy pass. The decision is left to the user.
The answer is entirely in Chinese.

agent_unsure: The agent saved the image without a position and the backend put it at position 4. It found no backend image policy. host.view_image returns a text description, not the image. It did not look up linked listings and only warned that the image may carry over to them.
